description:
## Functional specifications and files
Extend lib/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live.ex and its template/tab routing; add system_config/web_browsing_tab.ex. Reuse DesignSystem.DataSourceFolderPicker, shared DataSourceBrowser source/state/destination helpers, and existing new-folder modal. Add a comma-separated Allowed domains input and independent screenshot destination datasource/folder selection. Preserve provider/config/scope/canonical folder identity, not only a display path. Use existing enabled create-capable sources. Saving is through Engine events, not direct Agent/Channels/System calls. Reuse focused picker orchestration; do not clone all Skills-specific handlers or redesign the Skills tab.

## UX contract
Helper text: empty domains allows any domain; exact hostnames must include required redirect/resource hosts. Explain domain settings require Agent-container restart, including loss of ephemeral browser state. Do not imply Save changed existing browsers immediately. Destination updates apply to subsequent screenshots. Display the chosen source/folder, no-source/unconfigured/error states, retained edits on save failure, validation and success feedback. Empty destination disables screenshot persistence but not browsing. Admin-only according to existing System Configuration route/event authorization.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Extend test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/system_config_live_test.exs and component tests: tab navigation, admin authorization, normalized save/validation, failed save retains edits, root/child/up navigation, scope and opaque folder-ID preservation, source switching, choosing/creating a folder, disabled datasource and no sources, reset/cancel picker without changing saved settings, restart notice and destination change. Preserve Skills picker regressions. E2E scenarios planned separately, not authored now.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse DataSourceFolderPicker + DataSourceBrowser and existing folder creation operation. Extend only generic helper gaps with shared tests; do not copy skill-resource upload/pinning logic. Related work zaq-0oy and zaq-dqu must be checked for overlap before editing; neither is assumed a prerequisite without live verification.

## Mocking and documentation
Real internal event flow and fixtures; control external provider listing/create calls through established seams. Read DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, system-config and BO auth guides; local bundled styling only. Update System config guide and reuse/add component story only if component contract changes.

## Execution constraints and policies
Planning only; do not mark complete without implementation evidence. Future implementation uses a new branch in the current worktree, not another worktree; do not commit/push without authorization. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Read each affected module @moduledoc and relevant service owner before editing. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle rather than inventing alternate gates. Preserve existing assertions. New feature E2E authoring is deferred until the separate human approval issue closes.
